full_name: Linda Gordon | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2013–2014 History Matina S. Horner Distinguished Visiting Professor New York University
bio: Linda Gordon is a professor of history and a University Professor of the Humanities at New York University. Her early books focused on the historical roots of social policy issues, particularly as they concern gender and family issues.
